build_multimodal_inputs: build multimodal input arrays from DSTC format JSON dialogue data for training baselines
convert_pool_matrices: convert utterance pools into padded token matrices using a word-to-index vocabulary dictionary
convert_pool_matrices_pretrained_tokeniz: convert utterance pools into padded token matrices using a pretrained BERT tokenizer
get_save_path: get the output numpy file path given a save folder and input JSON filename
main: run the CLI entry point to process JSON dialogue files and save multimodal input arrays
